print('TOTAL RECEIPTS index', total_receipt_idx.tolist())
# Print rows around total
if len(total_receipt_idx)>0:
    idx = total_receipt_idx[0]
    print(df_raw.iloc[idx-5:idx+5].to_string(index=False, header=False))

import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/sahyog_budget_and_receipts.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Finance FY25-26', header=None)

# Identify receipt rows by Receipt ID starting with RCPT-
receipt_mask = df_raw[0].astype(str).str.startswith('RCPT-')
receipt_df = df_raw[receipt_mask].copy()
# Assign column names from row 22 (header)
header_row = df_raw.iloc[22]
cols = [str(x) if pd.notna(x) else '' for x in header_row]
receipt_df.columns = cols
# Clean column names
receipt_df = receipt_df.rename(columns={cols[0]:'Receipt ID', cols[1]:'Credit Date', cols[2]:'Donor / Scheme', cols[3]:'Donor Type', cols[4]:'Programme Tagged', cols[5]:'Amount Received (INR)', cols[6]:'Bank Reference'})
# Ensure Amount is numeric
receipt_df['Amount Received (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(receipt_df['Amount Received (INR)'], errors='coerce')
# Drop rows where Amount is NaN
receipt_df = receipt_df.dropna(subset=['Amount Received (INR)'])
print('Number of receipt rows:', len(receipt_df))
print(receipt_df[['Receipt ID','Donor / Scheme','Amount Received (INR)']].head(30).to_string(index=False))

# Sum by donor
sum_by_donor = receipt_df.groupby('Donor / Scheme')['Amount Received (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
sum_by_donor = sum_by_donor.sort_values('Amount Received (INR)', ascending=False)
print('\nSum by donor:')
print(sum_by_donor.to_string(index=False))
# Identify top donor
top = sum_by_donor.iloc[0]
print('\nTop donor:', top['Donor / Scheme'], top['Amount Received (INR)'])
